form.heading: Request a quote
form.lead: The more specific, the more precise the answer. Roof type, rough area, what you have noticed — and two or three photos if you can.
form.name: Name
form.phoneOptional: optional, gets you an answer sooner
form.messageHint: For example: clay tile roof, about 120 m², built 1978, water stain on an upstairs ceiling.
form.photosHint: A photo says more than a page of text. Images are resized automatically before upload.
form.photosDrop: Choose photos or drop them here
form.consent: I agree that my details may be stored in order to handle this enquiry.
form.emergencyHint: With water actively coming in, a call is faster than this form. Phone:
form.responsePromise: We reply within one working day.
form.successBody: You will get a confirmation email in a moment with a summary. We will reply within one working day.
form.successDemo: Note: no credentials are configured yet. The enquiry was validated but neither stored nor sent.
form.errorBody: The enquiry could not be submitted. Please try again — or call us, which works in any case.

errors.name: Please tell us your name so we know how to address you.
errors.nameLong: That is rather long for a name field — please shorten it.
errors.email: Please give an email address where we can reach you.
errors.phone: That phone number looks too long.
errors.urgency: Please tell us how urgent this is — it decides how quickly we come back to you.
errors.service: Please pick roughly what this is about. If you are unsure, choose “Roofing”.
errors.postalCode: Please give the postcode so we can work out the journey.
errors.messageShort: One or two more sentences would help us a great deal — what exactly have you noticed?
errors.messageLong: That is more text than we can handle here. Please shorten it, or call us.
errors.consent: Without your consent we are not allowed to store the enquiry.
errors.photoType: We cannot read that file format. JPG, PNG or WebP will work.
errors.photoSize: That image is too large. Please choose a smaller one.
errors.photoMax: We cannot accept more than {max} images.

form.mapNotice: The map is only loaded from OpenStreetMap once you click. Until then no request leaves your browser.
